sections.h2: What Hills of Lakeway homes are like
paragraphs: The Hills is one of the bigger gated communities around Lake Travis. It has 600+ homes spread over several plat phases, numbered Hills of Lakeway Phase 1 through 9 and beyond. Homes run from about 2,000 to 7,000 square feet, and prices go from the high $400Ks up to around $2.7M. You can read the age of the place in the houses. Some date to the 1980s, with the stone and stucco of that era. Others are new builds with big walls of glass. A Hills Country Club social membership comes with the home, so plenty of owners spend their days on the course side of the property.

Because the community went up in phases over decades, no two streets feel quite the same. Mature live oaks and cedars shade the older sections, while newer phases have younger landscaping and more open sky. The ground is hilly, so many homes sit above the street with long driveways and glass pointed at the views. That mix is why we quote from the real size of your home and not from a flat rate.

Golf course irrigation is the first thing we see. Overspray from the sprinklers lands on glass facing the fairways and dries into white mineral spots, and after a few seasons it can etch the glass. Our pure water system is a dual RO, 4 stage setup with a DI resin tank, so the water is near 0 TDS and the glass dries with no spots and no soap film. Add cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April, and a window can look dull in a week. Big view windows on the back of the house show every streak in afternoon sun.

Older phases often have trees close to the walls, which means spider webs, leaf litter in the screens and grit in the tracks. Screens run $5 each and tracks $5, and hard water spot removal in The Hills of Lakeway is $10 per pane when minerals have set in. Tall newer glass is easier than it looks, because our water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground at The Hills of Lakeway.

sections.h2: How we work The Hills of Lakeway
paragraphs: The guard gate is part of every job here. Text us the address and a good day, add us to your guest list, and pass along any gate details ahead of time. Our truck carries an 8 ft skid with 200 gallons of water on board, so we never need to hook into your spigot. We like to stack several homes in one phase on the same visit, which keeps travel short and helps us fit you in, usually within two weeks. Window cleaning pairs well with a house soft wash, since our 12V soft wash system handles stucco and limestone without pressure. If you are unsure about exterior rules, check with the Hills of Lakeway HOA.

A typical 4,000 square foot home here comes to about $400 for the exterior, which is about 40 windows at $10 each. Exterior time on site runs about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so plan on three to four hours. Doing the inside of a The Hills of Lakeway home adds about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft. The minimum job is $200, and quotes come by text, usually within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: Do you get through the guard gate at The Hills?
faq.a: Yes. Text us your address and add us to your guest list or tell us your gate process. We arrive ready to check in, so you do not need to meet us at the gate.

faq.q: Can you remove the white spots from sprinkler overspray?
faq.a: Usually. Fresh mineral spots come off with our pure water. Spots that have sat for seasons may need hard water spot removal at $10 per pane, and badly etched glass may not fully clear.

faq.q: How much for a large Hills home?
faq.a: Exterior windows are about $0.10 per sq ft or $10 per window, so a 5,000 sq ft home is about $500. Inside and out in The Hills of Lakeway is $15 per window. Text photos or the address for an exact quote.

faq.q: Do you clean the upstairs glass on tall homes?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground at The Hills of Lakeway, so exterior glass needs no ladder against the house. Inside, we hand squeegee every pane and lay drop cloths first.

faq.q: Should I add a house soft wash with my windows?
faq.a: Many Hills owners do. House soft wash in The Hills of Lakeway starts at $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum, and it clears pollen and algae from stucco and limestone without pressure damage.
